## Main concepts

| Term         | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Form         | An Excel workbook used to collect data.                                      |
| Form model   | A versioned definition of a form’s sheets, fields, layout and constraints.   |
| Consumer     | A package, tool or application that uses the package’s operations.           |

## Reference data and lookups

| Term                   | Meaning                                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Reference catalogue    | A named collection of reference tables.                                                 |
| Reference source       | The location, cache and optional credentials used to retrieve a catalogue.              |
| Reference table        | A table of records used to interpret or check submitted values.                         |
| Lookup configuration   | Named columns and matching settings used to search reference tables.                    |
| Lookup index           | A prepared structure used to find matching reference rows.                              |
| Alias                  | An alternative value explicitly mapped to a canonical reference value.                  |
| Reference cache        | Local files retained after catalogue and checksum verification.                         |
| Reference snapshot     | Reference data and lookup settings retained for consumers to reuse.                     |
| Checksum               | A content fingerprint used to detect whether a downloaded file matches its catalogue.   |
